entries.summary: Solving x² − x/v = mc with the quadratic formula, then a look at what changes if c is the speed of light (including a units check).
Reading handwritten notes on the definition u = logₙ v ⇔ nᵘ = v, with examples like log₆₀ 60 = 1.

entries.statusNote: Personal notation. Turn 1 is ordinary base 3 with renamed digits; the later u/p/i mapping is Joshua's own construction, not a standard numeral system.
entries.summary: A three-letter 'binary-like' system with digits u, p, i: first as base 3, then a custom mapping, plus a binary converter.
Distance = (3/2)πr: the arc length of a 270° path.
Sampling the parametric unit circle x = cos θ, y = sin θ at a 0.1 rad step, in Python.
The 3×3 identity matrix and its properties: IA = AI = A, det I = 1, I⁻¹ = I, eigenvalues all 1.
How vectors and (homogeneous) transform matrices drive sprites in real-time graphics. Qualitative, no equations.

entries.statusNote: Invented framework. 'Fold Calculus' was made up in this chat as a new formal system. It is a personal, speculative construction, not established mathematics, and has not been peer reviewed.
entries.summary: An invented 'Fold Calculus' built on sequences of crests and troughs: fold derivative, fold integral, a fundamental theorem, a worked example, and a coding loop.
Reading 100/9.65² as the variance of a sample mean (σ²/n), standard error, CEP, and a Python Monte Carlo check.
Drift rate across fields: the μ in dY = μ dt + σ dW, biased random walks, drift-diffusion models, and electron drift velocity.
Can a classical computer be modeled from a Bell state? Bell states, no-signaling, and a CHSH calculation reaching |S| = 2√2.

entries.statusNote: Exploratory. The starting expression H = xz² − x/m is Joshua's own. The chat offers possible interpretations and a simulation of one of them, not an established model.
entries.summary: Interpreting H = xz² − x/m as a qubit or anharmonic-oscillator Hamiltonian, a QuTiP simulation, and printing circuits in a terminal.

entries.statusNote: Exploratory. The relation π² = E·m − c is Joshua's own proposal. As the chat points out, it is dimensionally inconsistent as written, so it is not a physical law.
entries.summary: A units check of the proposed π² = E·m − c, and dimensionally consistent rearrangements involving E = mc².
Turning a physics notebook page into a SymPy program: v = 2πr/T, vector magnitude, and KE/PE/momentum placeholders.
Using a free-spinning bearing as a motion sensor: s = 2πrN, friction decay Iω̇ = −τ_f, and a predict-then-correct residual.
A bisection root finder in C: sign-change check, interval halving, stopping rules, and status codes.
